create_reducer_subclass: create a python subclass of Reducer that implements reduce, save_state, and load_state methods
implement_reduce_method: implement the reduce method on a Reducer subclass to aggregate results from a set of runners
implement_save_state: implement the save_state method on a Reducer subclass to checkpoint state to a given location
implement_load_state: implement the load_state method on a Reducer subclass to restore state from a checkpoint location
use_mock_reducer: use MockReducer to test reduction logic by printing runner config args without real computation
